scoring_justification: Recompute derived quantities (shear moduli, internal consistency B from Cijs) and compare agent-reported values against paper gold with relative tolerances; full recompute of headline metric from raw DFT outputs is feasible via derived property checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for BaS and BaSe from paper Tables 1 and 2, plus derived shear moduli computed from paper's elastic constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper tables 1 and 2; lattice constants, bulk modulus (+ derivative), elastic constants C11, C12, C44, anisotropy ratio, Poisson ratio, wave velocities, Debye temperature; shear moduli computed from formulas (2)-(3) and average using the paper's Cij.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper; shear moduli computed via Python script using exact Cij values and recorded inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact paper-reported numbers or deterministic derivations from them.

outputs.description: Final material properties for BaS and BaSe computed from DFT and elastic derivations.

output_contract.notes: Values will be compared to hidden reference (paper‑reported) data using tolerances that account for typical toolchain and pseudopotential variability. Internal self‑consistency (bulk modulus from elastic constants vs from EOS) may also be checked.

steps.description: Aggregate score for BaS: lattice constant, bulk modulus (and derivative), elastic constants, derived isotropic shear moduli, anisotropy, Poisson ratio, wave velocities, Debye temperature, and internal consistency of bulk modulus from Cij.
Aggregate score for BaSe (same set of quantities).
